objective.text: Prevent duplicate job deliveries from creating duplicate database results with a unique operation key.

difficulty.rationale: Make the durable result identify the logical operation across repeated job attempts.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A job may be delivered twice after a worker loses its acknowledgment. Its sole side effect is inserting an export-request row. The same logical request must create at most one such row. Which boundary enforces this even after a previous job has completed?

options.text: Set tries=1 and assume acknowledgment loss cannot cause another delivery.
options.rationale: An attempt limit does not turn the queue transport into exactly-once delivery.
options.misconception: An attempt limit does not turn the queue transport into exactly-once delivery.

options.text: Check whether the row exists and then insert without any constraint.
options.rationale: Concurrent deliveries can both pass the separate check before either insert becomes visible.
options.misconception: Concurrent deliveries can both pass the separate check before either insert becomes visible.

options.text: Use ShouldBeUnique alone and remove all database uniqueness.
options.rationale: A dispatch uniqueness lock is released during the job lifecycle and is not a permanent record of completed business operations.
options.misconception: A dispatch uniqueness lock is released during the job lifecycle and is not a permanent record of completed business operations.

options.text: Use a stable request key with a unique database constraint and treat its duplicate as the existing result.
options.rationale: Durable uniqueness on the operation identity prevents repeated deliveries from inserting another result row.

explanation.summary: Durable uniqueness on the operation identity prevents repeated deliveries from inserting another result row.
